taper_start_x.interpretation: Start ahead of the existing wall-angle attachment; no printed station. Bounds are not qualified ranges.

taper_end_x.interpretation: Finish before the brake rim enters the casing footprint; no printed station. Bounds are not qualified ranges.

front_outside_width.interpretation: Local reduced width chosen to clear the scaled brake rim while retaining the chain; original168.275mm maximum remains behind the taper. Bounds are not qualified ranges.

small_hub_radius.interpretation: Clear the inferred brake hub, which is larger than the prior sprocket-only envelope. Bounds are not qualified ranges.

hub_gap.interpretation: Static radial gap at the brake hub. Bounds are not qualified ranges.

minimum_rotor_gap.interpretation: Minimum candidate drum-to-casing separation; not a historical tolerance. Bounds are not qualified ranges.
